item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 17 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 17 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 18 August 2026(Tuesday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Batangas, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Iba, Palauig, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Cavite(Alfonso, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Maragondon, Ternate, Indang, Mendez, Tagaytay).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Pampanga, Zambales(Candelaria, Masinloc, Santa Cruz), Tarlac(Camiling, San Clemente, Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Silang, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza), Bulacan(Paombong, Malolos, Calumpit, Hagonoy, Pulilan, Plaridel, Guiguinto, Bulakan, Meycauayan, Marilao, Obando, Bocaue, Balagtas), Laguna(San Pablo, Alaminos, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro) and Quezon(San Antonio, Tiaong).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada, Santa Ignacia) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Nueva Ecija(Carranglan, Pantabangan, Lupao, San Jose), Bulacan(Baliuag, Bustos, Pandi, Santa Maria, San Jose del Monte, Norzagaray, Angat, San Rafael), Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Mauban, Lucena, Tayabas, Lucban, Sampaloc, Candelaria, Dolores, Sariaya, San Francisco, San Andres) and Laguna(Cavinti, Lumban, Kalayaan, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Siniloan, Famy, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Liliw, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Luisiana) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
